Priya: heads-up — saw long-context memory growth and paged-KV thrashing on MI250 when seq > 64k; behavior diverges from H100/A100. attaching profiler excerpt.
Alex: can you paste the perf counters + pager logs?
Priya: repro excerpt:
```
PAGER_STATS: hit_rate=0.92 reuse_window=2048 evict_rate=0.06
PAGEWALK: mi250x: avg_walk_cycles=4200, h100: avg_walk_cycles=1200
KV_PTABLE: fragment_pct=18.3 liveness=0.42
TRACE: kernel=vectorized_prefetch_v2 selected_by=kernelselect#42
```
Riley: fwiw we flipped kernel selection last week to `vectorized_prefetch_v2` — it prefetches more aggressively, so throughput up but PT live set grows. could explain mem growth.
jen: remember batching heuristics change too — max_batch_seq bumped to 4096. that increases concurrent KV pressure.
Sean: repro'd on H100 w/ NVLink: observed cascade evictions. eviction order isn't global-LRU across shards -> fragmentation increases.
Liang: suspect page-table tombstone race when migration overlaps with async prefetch/unmap. minimal repro steps:
1) enable vectorized_prefetch_v2
2) run longctx workload @ seq=80k, batch=64
3) trigger migration with `--migrate=on`
Observed: stale owner refs in PT after evict -> stale ref prevents reclaim -> growth over time.
Priya: uploaded traces + perf recording: /perf/artifacts/6754321987/prefetch-throttle.tar.gz
infra-bot: nightly-run 6754321987-kv-paged-prefetch results: h100=FAIL, mi250=FAIL, a100=PASS
Alex: mitigation idea: throttle prefetch depth per-arch as short-term. reduce vectorized prefetch window.
Liang: will add `--kv-prefetch-depth` flag and per-arch defaults (H100=8, A100=16, MI250=4). PR planned.
jen: also add metrics to console: `kv_pt_fragmentation_ratio` and `kv_longctx_live_pages` + alert when growth > 5%/hour.
Sean: spun up canary on dedicated pool w/ throttling patch. will run 24h longctx test.
Priya: next steps: (a) produce minimal reproducer script `tools/kv_repro.py` (b) add prefetch throttle + opt-in kernel flag (c) collect pagewalk/pmap traces across hw and compare. I'll update thread when artifacts are in.
Alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
